title: Generalized Reduced-Density-Matrix Quantum Monte Carlo Gives Access to More
summary: For a long time, people have been focusing on how to extract more information, such as off-diagonal observables, from the quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulation of the partition function, but there have been numerous difficulties, and many of them are insurmountable. In this article, we point out that all the difficulties stem from the starting point of the simulation: calculating a partition function.
